title: Next.js upgrade — the deferred decision
verification: eslint: 10 errors before the upgrade, 10 after - all pre-existing, none introduced.
Production server (npm start), 13 routes: home, PLP, PDP, cart, both quote steps, saved-quotes, llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and a public PDF all 200.

Proxy still gates correctly: /admin 404s even with a forged isLoggedIn cookie, and an unknown path 404s. This mattered because one advisory fixed here is a middleware/proxy bypass under Turbopack, and this app relies on proxy.ts.
PDP configurator prices and adds to cart. The quote Server Action submits, the httpOnly draft cookie survives the redirect, the review page greets by name and the guest lead persists. No page errors.

findings.fix: Upgraded next 16.2.7 -> 16.3.4 (npm install next@16.3.4 --save-exact, keeping this project's exact-pin convention). This was the decision batch 1 deferred: npm reported the fix as outside the stated range because package.json pinned 16.2.7 exactly. 16.3.4 is a minor within Next 16, not a major.

findings.fix: Resolved by the next 16.2.7 -> 16.3.4 upgrade. postcss is pinned by Next's own dependency tree, so it could not move independently — which is why it was deferred with next rather than fixed in batch 1. 8.4.31, 8.5.20 -> 8.5.23, 8.5.28
